patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Amplemarket and Kaspr share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Frame: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Amplemarket and Kaspr share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.. Choose Amplemarket only if your buying job matches “AI-powered multichannel outbound platform combining lead intelligence, sequences, delivera” rather than Kaspr's shape. Choose Kaspr only if your buying job matches “LinkedIn-centric EU/EMEA B2B contact capture (Chrome) — Free plan; Starter from $49/mo ann” rather than Amplemarket's shape. Workflow advantage: Amplemarket leans sales-engagement, email-outreach; Kaspr leans data-enrichment, lead-management. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Amplemarket and Kaspr share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Amplemarket is AI-powered multichannel outbound platform combining lead intelligence, sequences, deliverability, and Duo AI assistants.; Kaspr is LinkedIn-centric EU/EMEA B2B contact capture (Chrome) — Free plan; Starter from $49/mo annual headline..
- Workflow coverage skew: Amplemarket-leaning sales-engagement, email-outreach vs Kaspr-leaning data-enrichment, lead-management.
- Researched limits: Amplemarket — Not a full CRM pipeline system of record.; Kaspr — LinkedIn-centric capture — coverage and compliance depend on LinkedIn workflow policies.

Limitations — Amplemarket: Not a full CRM pipeline system of record.; Startup already $600/mo annual; Growth/Elite are custom-quoted.; Kaspr: LinkedIn-centric capture — coverage and compliance depend on LinkedIn workflow policies; Native email outreach/sequencing depth is limited versus engagement platforms.

Poor-fit cases: Amplemarket is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a full CRM pipeline system of record. · Kaspr is a poor fit when that limitation bites: LinkedIn-centric capture — coverage and compliance depend on LinkedIn workflow policies · Avoid Amplemarket if you actually need Kaspr's motion (LinkedIn-centric EU/EMEA B2B contact capture (Chrome) — Free plan; Starter from )

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
